examples.title: Site-driven association
examples.question: Does the imaging measurement increase with age?
examples.setup: Site changes the measurement, and participants at one site are older. The initial plan omits site.
examples.lesson: The apparent age association reflects a site difference that the plan does not account for.

examples.title: Discovery-only association
examples.short: A signal that does not repeat
examples.question: Does the imaging measurement decrease with age?
examples.setup: The simulated measurement decreases with age in discovery. The independent replication sample has no age effect.
examples.lesson: The discovery association passes Screen. The missing replication withholds it under Replicate and Full.
